newsitem.title: USA: Reuters, Wired Ventures in joint news deal.
newsitem.headline: Reuters, Wired Ventures in joint news deal.

text.p: Reuters America Inc said Monday that it and HotWired Inc will launch the Reuters/Wired Digital News Service, which will combine news stories from HotWired's Wired News news service, Wired magazine and related web sites with news and visual content from Reuters.
HotWired Inc is the interactive media division of Wired Ventures, the publisher of Wired Magazine. In October, Wired Ventures withdrew its planned initial public offering, citing market conditions.
The daily news service will be available in the first quarter of 1997 from Reuters.
The service will provide coverage on people, companies, technologies and culture of the digital age, Reuters said.

It will also offer text, audio, video and photographic content from Reuters, and will be marketed to newspapers, magazines and broadcasters as well as online and internet publishers worldwide, the companies said.

"Reuters is excited to be working on a daily online product with Wired and HotWired, ventures that have become synonymous with the latest in cultural, political and technological news for the Information Age," said Andrew Nibley, executive vice president, media, new media and television of Reuters America.
Reuters America is the primary operating entity in America of Reuters Holdings Plc.
